actions.addPage.description: Add new pages to your chatbot’s knowledge base.
actions.addPage.props.chatbotId.descript: The ID of your chatbot (can be found in the URL when viewing your bot: /bot/YOUR_BOT_ID)
actions.addPage.props.sessionCookie.desc: Session cookie for crawling sites behind login
actions.addPage.props.urls.description: List of webpage URLs to add to your chatbot's knowledge base (e.g., "https://wonderchat.io")
actions.addTag.description: Add custom tags to a specific chatlog.
actions.addTag.props.chatlogId.descripti: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")
actions.addTag.props.tags.description: List of URLs to add to your chatbot
actions.askQuestion.description: Sends a question to a Wonderchat bot; returns the bot’s answer.
actions.askQuestion.props.chatbotId.desc: The ID of your chatbot (can be found in the URL when viewing your bot: /bot/YOUR_BOT_ID)
actions.askQuestion.props.chatlogId.desc: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")
actions.askQuestion.props.context.descri: Additional custom context about the chat session (e.g., user information)
actions.askQuestion.props.contextUrl.des: URL of the page the user is on to provide additional context
actions.askQuestion.props.question.descr: The question you wish to ask your chatbot
actions.removeTag.description: Remove specific tags from a chatlog.
actions.removeTag.props.chatlogId.descri: The ID of your chat session (can be found under Chatlog Details section, labeled as "ID")
auth.description:
1. Log in to your Wonderchat account.
  2. Click on your **Profile card**.
  2. Go to your **User settings**.
  3. Click on the the **API keys** tab.
  3. If you already have a key, copy it, if not generate one.
description: Wonderchat is a no-code chatbot platform that lets you deploy AI-powered chatbots for websites quickly.
